Rachid Behna

Please the cards again be: the bank [illegible], Mister H. Labat, Mister H. Sarr, Mister J. Soret.

This evening the gentlemen you will receive the 200 pounds... I hope to send you tomorrow the settlement for the week.

I am in sales and please note [illegible] suits you.

Thanks: There was a small movement because the Messageries reduced for the transport from Zaghouan, and the railways made a reduction very early; but still I am convinced that soon this will end well in service...

[illegible] The workers [illegible] have just placed an order for:

5000 red boxes at 7 francs 10.
5000 orange boxes at 7 francs 18.

and they hope for another order [illegible]. [illegible] told us he is satisfied [illegible]; no news of an increase in [illegible].
